verdict.line: You lose if you let him farm Q stacks uncontested behind minions; you win by level 6 if you land Q and chain into Devour.

brief.thesis: Nasus has zero mobility and no escape outside Q (Siphoning Strike, 255 range) and W (Wither, 700 range, 15/14/13/12/11s cooldown) — he cannot create distance once you're on him. Tahm Kench's Q (Tongue Lash, 7-5.5s cooldown, 900 range) outranges his entire kit and both slows and stacks An Acquired Taste, so every landed Q is a death sentence if he's near 3 stacks. This shows up directly in the 58.7% win rate over 286 games, well above your 50.7% baseline in the role.

theirWindow.when: Nasus Q is up and he's farming
theirWindow.what: He has to walk up to a minion to cast Q (255 range), which puts him in your Q range first. Punish the animation lock, don't let him free-farm it.

yourWindow.when: He's within 900 range and under 3 stacks
yourWindow.what: Land Q to slow and stack him, then follow with autos. At 3 stacks your next Q stuns him outright — that's the kill window, since he has no dash or blink to escape it.

playing.title: Punish his Q animation
playing.detail: Nasus must walk into melee range (255) to last-hit with Siphoning Strike. Step up and Q him the moment he commits to a cast.

playing.title: Track stacks, not health
playing.detail: An Acquired Taste caps at 3 stacks; once he's there, your next landed Q stuns and consumes them. Plan your all-in around that stun, not just his HP bar.

playing.title: Devour at 3 stacks, not before
playing.detail: R (Devour) only becomes usable on him at 3 Passive stacks. Don't waste the cooldown window — hold it until you can combo Q-stun into R.

playing.title: Respect Wither at level 2+
playing.detail: Wither (15-11s cooldown) kills your kiting and attack speed for its duration. Expect his all-in the moment it's up, and don't greed autos into it.

playing.title: Zone his farm with Q
playing.detail: Your 900-range Q outranges every tool he has. Threaten minions near him constantly to deny Siphoning Strike stacks, which is his only scaling.

playing.title: Play around his empty Fury of the Sands
playing.detail: Before level 6 and between its 120s cooldowns, he has no sandstorm, no bonus range, and no healing drain. Your aggression windows are biggest in these stretches.

playing.title: Don't duel him post-6 at full stacks
playing.detail: If he's stacked Q kills for several levels, Fury of the Sands drains your max health and turns his autos into a bigger problem. Pull him into trades early rather than late.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and the 58.7% win rate figure are measured from 286 live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning behind the trade patterns and timing windows is my own analysis.

stats.opponentTip: Use [Q] to prevent him from retreating while attacking him with basic attacks to use [P]-[W] to swallow him whenever he closes in. He is an easy kill if [Q] lands as he lacks movement skills.
